blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Edge medical segmentation must reconcile small model size, high accuracy, and fast inference. TernScope addresses this tradeoff through model--hardware co-design, learning a compact segmentation network whose low-bit operators also simplify hardware execution. Split-channel large-kernel blocks preserve spatial context with limited computation, while branch fusion removes redundant inference paths. Ternary Progressive Quantization-aware Training (TPQ) then adapts the fused network from deep to shallow layers, through the decoder, and finally to the input and prediction layers. All 25 convolutions use ternary weights and 8-bit activations, enabling packed storage and multiplier-free computation. The resulting model uses 0.2483 M parameters and 0.0949 GMACs while retaining competitive segmentation accuracy on in-domain and external datasets. Under the same 45 nm technology, TernScope reduces compute-array area by 88.46% compared with the original Gemmini, a systolic-array accelerator with 8-bit $\times$ 8-bit multipliers. These results demonstrate a path from accurate lightweight medical segmentation to compact low-bit hardware.
blocks.zh: 边缘医学分解必须调和小模型大小,高精度,快速推论. TernScope通过模型-硬件共设计解决了这种取舍,学习了紧凑的分块网络,其低位运算器也简化了硬件执行. 分化-通道大内核块以有限的计算方式保留了空间上下文,而分支聚变则去除冗余的推论路径. 然后通过解码器将引信网络从深层到浅层进行再调整,最后调整为输入和预测层。 所有25个演化体都使用三相重和8位活化,使被打包的存储和无倍数计算成为可能. 由此产生的模型使用了0.2483 M参数和0.0949 GMAC,同时保留了内域和外域数据集的竞争分化精度. 在同为45nm的技术下,TernScope将计算阵列面积与最初的Gemmini相比减少了88.46%,而Gemmini是一个具有8-times $\times 8-times乘数的同位素-阵列加速器. 这些结果显示了从精确的轻量级医疗分解到紧凑的低位硬件的路径.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Medical image segmentation at the edge faces a model size–accuracy–inference speed trilemma : a deployable model must fit limited memory, delineate lesions accurately, and deliver predictions promptly [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Reducing network width or spatial processing can save resources, but also restrict the contextual information available for segmentation [ 4 , 5 ] . The goal is therefore to retain strong segmentation capacity within a small, fast model. For endoscopic applications, this requires treating predictive quality and deployment cost as joint design objectives.
blocks.zh: 边缘的医学图像分解面临模型大小 — — 准确度 — — 推论速度三重力马:可部署模型必须适应有限的内存,准确描述损伤,并迅速作出预测[1,2,3]。 减少网络宽度或空间处理可以节约资源,但也限制了可用于分割的背景资料[4,5]. 因此,目标是在一个小型、快速的模型中保持强大的分化能力。 对于内观应用而言,这需要将预测质量和部署成本作为联合设计目标。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: TernScope training-to-deployment pipeline. Branch fusion removes redundant inference paths; TPQ adapts the fused graph to W2A8, including the stem and head.
blocks.zh: 图1:TernScope训练至部署管道。 分支聚变可以去除冗余的推论路径;TPQ将被熔化的图表调整为W2A8,包括干和头.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: TernScope-Net and its main components. SplitLK combines a split-channel large-kernel path with a bypass and pointwise mixing. RepLK training branches are fused into a single deployment convolution. The Nearest Unifier combines projected features from four encoder scales.
blocks.zh: 图2:TernScope-Net及其主要组件. SplitLK将一个分裂通道的大内核路径与绕行和指向混合相结合. RepLK训练分队被整合为单一的部署演化. 最接近的统一者结合了四个编码器尺度的预测特征.

blocks.en: A compact network does not automatically translate into fast inference or a small accelerator. Execution also depends on memory access, operator organization, and the target architecture [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] . Structural re-parameterization helps by merging expressive training branches into efficient inference operators [ 9 , 10 ] . Numerical precision provides a complementary design dimension: low-bit operands reduce tensor storage and simplify arithmetic [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] . Combining these choices makes full-network ternary weight quantization an opportunity to address the trilemma at both model and circuit levels, provided segmentation accuracy can be retained.
blocks.zh: 紧凑的网络不会自动转化为快速推论或小加速器. 执行还取决于内存访问,操作组织,以及目标架构[6,7,8]. 结构再参数化有助于将表达式训练分支合并成高效的推论操作员[9,10]. 数字精度提供了一个互补的设计维度:低位的歌词会减少拉伸存储,简化算术[11,12,13]. 将这些选择结合起来,使全网络的三重量量化成为在模型和电路两级解决三聚体问题的机会,前提是能保留分区精度。

blocks.en: The central challenge is to make a compact segmentation graph learn effectively under ternary constraints. Learned quantization scales and incremental conversion provide complementary ways to adapt networks to reduced precision [ 14 , 15 ] . Branch fusion changes the effective kernels, so quantizing separate training branches need not yield the same operator as quantizing their sum. Leaving the stem or prediction head at higher weight precision also retains heterogeneous convolution requirements. We instead adapt the fused deployment graph through Ternary Progressive QAT (TPQ), extending ternary weights to every convolution while retaining 8-bit activations.
blocks.zh: 中心挑战是使一个紧凑的分割图在三位一体的限制下有效学习。 所学的量化尺度和增量转换提供了使网络适应降低精度[14、15]的补充方法。 分支聚变会改变有效的内核,因此对单独的训练分支进行量化不需要产生与对它们的和进行定量相同的操作员. 将干头或预测头留在更高的重量精度上,也保留了不同的演化要求。 我们转而通过Trinary Progress QAT(TPQ)调整引信部署图,将毒性重量扩大到每个演化,同时保留8位激活.

blocks.en: TernScope realizes this model-led co-design in three connected steps (Fig. 1 ). SplitLK allocates large-kernel processing to a channel subset, and a narrow decoder fuses multi-scale features. Branch fusion removes redundant execution paths before TPQ learns the final low-bit operators. A corresponding ternary array then translates the model’s numerical representation into simpler computation.
blocks.zh: TernScope实现这个模型引导的共设计,分三个连接步骤(图1). SplitLK将大内核处理分配到一个通道子集,狭义的解码器引信会具有多级特性. 分支聚变在TPQ学习最终低位运算符之前删除冗余执行路径. 相应的三位数组然后将模型的数值表示转化为更简单的计算.

blocks.en:
We present TernScope, a fully ternary-weight segmentation

blocks.en: II TernScope-Net
blocks.zh: 二、TernScope网络

blocks.en: II-A SplitLK: Spatial Context at Low Cost
blocks.zh: II-A SplitLK:低成本空间环境

Its four encoder stages use 32/64/96/128 channels, while spatial convolutions process only 16/16/16/32 channels. The remaining channels bypass spatial processing and rejoin the transformed features before a pointwise mixer. For example, processing 32 of 128 channels reduces this spatial term to 1 / 16 1/16 of its full-width counterpart; the pointwise cost remains. Large kernels of size 5, 7, and 9 operate at 32 × 32 32\times 32 resolution or below, where wider context is less expensive.

blocks.en: II-B Nearest Unifier: Narrow Multi-Scale Fusion
blocks.zh: II-B 最接近的单体: 窄式多比例融合

blocks.en: The Nearest Unifier projects all four encoder scales to 16 channels. Nearest-neighbor resizing aligns the features for addition and convolutional refinement. The three deeper features are combined and refined before fusion with the shallow feature, so the decoder introduces semantic context before recovering fine detail. Addition keeps the fused width at 16 channels instead of growing it through concatenation. Nearest-neighbor resizing requires no learned upsampling weights. Convolutions learn spatial refinement, while dense kernels and channel widths aligned to 16 suit a common array.
blocks.zh: 最接近的Unifier将所有四个编码器尺度投射到16个频道. 近邻调整大小 调整特征 用于加成和进化完善。 三个更深的特征在与浅的特征融合之前被结合和完善,因此解码器在恢复细细细节之前引入语义上下文. 加法使引信宽度保持在16个信道上,而不是通过接合而生长。 近邻重整大小不需要有学识的上标重量. Cirvolutions学习空间完善,而密集的内核和信道宽度与16个套装对齐是一个常见的阵列.

blocks.en: IV-A Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: IV-A 评价议定书

blocks.en: Training uses Kvasir-SEG [ 23 ] only, split into 720/80/200 training/validation/test images. ClinicDB (612) [ 24 ] and ColonDB (380) [ 25 ] evaluate transfer without fine-tuning. RGB inputs are 256 × 256 256\times 256 , normalized to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] ; augmentation includes flips, right-angle rotations, color adjustment, and Gaussian blur. Images and masks use bilinear and nearest-neighbor resizing, respectively. Baselines use Adam, batch 16, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and binary cross-entropy plus soft Dice loss for 200 epochs. TPQ uses FP32 initialization, AdamW, batch 2, a base learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , and 200 epochs without distillation. Validation Dice selects checkpoints. Metrics average per-image scores at threshold 0.5. MACs count convolution, linear layers, and matrix multiplication at batch 1; Table I notes the partial WKV count.

blocks.en: IV-B Segmentation Quality and Quantization Ablation
blocks.zh: IV-B 分解质量和定量

blocks.en: Table I shows a favorable accuracy–cost tradeoff. TernScope uses approximately 1 / 125 1/125 of U-Net’s parameters and 1 / 508 1/508 of its MACs, with in-domain Dice within 0.51 percentage points and external Dice higher by 5.00 and 5.85 points. Smaller parameter count alone does not explain this result: EGE-UNet and Mobile-PolypNet have fewer parameters, yet lower overlap scores. TernScope retains spatial context within a compact W2A8 graph, with the strongest cross-dataset Dice and IoU among the evaluated models. Fig. 3 provides matched examples and enlarged boundary regions.
blocks.zh: 表一显示一个有利的准确性-成本权衡。 TernScope使用约1/1251/125的U-Net参数和1/508 1/508的MAC参数,域内剂量在0.51个百分点以内,外部剂量高5.00和5.85个百分点. 更小的参数数本身并不能解释这个结果:EGE-UNet和Mobile-PolypNet的参数较少,但重叠得分较低. TernScope在紧凑的W2A8图中保留空间上下文,在评价模型中具有最强的跨数据集Dice和IoU. 图3提供了相应的例子和扩大的边界区域。

blocks.en: Table II separates structural simplification from low-bit adaptation. Fusion removes 23.21% of parameters and 10.78% of MACs while preserving FP32 overlap scores. The resulting model does not tolerate ternary PTQ: segmentation collapses despite unchanged topology. QAT restores useful predictions, and TPQ improves external Dice over direct QAT by 2.62 and 3.09 points. It also exceeds the FP32 reference on all three datasets. Low-bit adaptation is therefore essential to exploiting the fused topology.
blocks.zh: 表二将结构简化与低位适应区分开来. Fusion取消了23.21%的参数和10.78%的MAC,同时保留了FP32的重叠分数. 由此形成的模型无法容忍trinary PTQ:尽管地形没有变化,但分裂崩溃. QAT恢复了有用的预测,TPQ将外部的Dice比直接QAT改进2.62和3.09点. 它还超过了所有三个数据集的FP32参考. 因此,低位适应对利用已融化的地形至关重要。

blocks.en:
At 100 MHz, TernScope delivers 102.701 FPS for the evaluated
workload, compared with 11.902 FPS for Gemmini, an
8.629 × \times throughput improvement. Ternary weights reduce
the packed weight footprint to one quarter of the INT8
representation, shrinking model storage and easing
weight-transfer pressure. The ternary array also replaces
general multiplications with sign selection and accumulation,
reducing the logic cost of convolution.

blocks.en:
The shared Affine & Quantization Engine further contributes
to throughput by performing per-channel scaling, bias addition,
multi-scale feature addition, and requantization on the
accelerator. This reduces the CPU post-processing overhead
present in the evaluated Gemmini mapping. For this workload,
logic energy cost decreases from 14.019 to
0.604 mJ per image, a 95.690% reduction.
This co-design translates ternary model compression into
high throughput and low logic energy cost.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: TernScope couples SplitLK, branch fusion, and TPQ to retain segmentation quality in a compact W2A8 graph. Cross-dataset evaluation and matched synthesis connect low-bit learning to a smaller compute array for edge endoscopy. A promising next step is to exploit zero-valued ternary weights through sparsity-aware execution and compressed storage, targeting lower computation and data-movement costs.
blocks.zh: TernScope夫妇 SplitLK,分支聚变,和TPQ在紧凑的W2A8图中保留分化质量. 跨数据集评价和匹配的合成将低位学习与一个较小的计算阵列连接起来,用于边缘内分镜. 下一个有希望的步骤是通过Sparersity-aware执行和压缩存储来利用零值三重力,目标是降低计算和数据移动成本。
